title: A Survey on Agentic Security: Applications, Threats and Defenses
abstract: arXiv:2510.06445v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work we present the first holistic survey of the agentic security landscape, structuring the field around the fundamental pillars of Applications, Threats and Defenses. We provide a comprehensive taxonomy of 274 papers that covers red-teaming, blue-teaming and domain-specific applications, attack surfaces on agentic systems, defense techniques, and both offensive and defensive evaluation frameworks. For each pillar, we first discuss the literature around the taxonomy and then perform a quantitative analysis to understand the patterns across these works. For the applications, we show their security-lifecycle coverage map, compare between red-teaming and blue-teaming agents, and analyze the adversarial use of red-teaming applications. translated_title: 智能体安全综述：应用、威胁与防御
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们提出了首个关于智能体安全领域的整体性综述，将该领域围绕应用、威胁和防御三大基本支柱进行结构化组织。我们提供了涵盖274篇论文的全面分类体系，内容包括红队攻击、蓝队防御和特定领域应用、智能体系统的攻击面、防御技术，以及攻防两方面的评估框架。对于每个支柱，我们首先围绕分类体系讨论相关文献，然后进行定量分析以理解这些研究工作之间的规律。在应用方面，我们展示了它们在安全生命周期中的覆盖图谱，比较了红队与蓝队智能体，并分析了红队应用的对抗性使用。在威胁方面，我们分析了攻击所针对的入口点和智能体循环阶段、攻击对智能体场景的特异性，以及它们所假设的威胁模型。在防御方面，我们分析了……
tldr: 本文是首个对智能体安全领域进行全面综述的工作，通过274篇论文的分类体系和定量分析，从应用、威胁和防御三大支柱系统性地构建了智能体安全领域的研究框架。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first holistic survey of the agentic security landscape, providing a comprehensive taxonomy of 274 papers with quantitative analysis structured around the three pillars of Applications, Threats, and Defenses.
